verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt file at docs.gitlab.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, GitLab Documentation header), so an agent can be pointed straight at it. GitLab also documents an Orbit skill that gives AI coding agents structured guidance, and publishes a raw, autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec as machine-readable API docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's breadth and structure (e.g., a full-content variant or per-page markdown), independent or hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
